backfill_news.headline: Westport to Showcase High-Pressure CNG Fuel System for North American Heavy-Duty Fleets at ACT Expo 2026
backfill_news.summary: Westport announced demonstration of next-generation compressed natural gas (CNG) fuel storage system combined with Cespira's HPDI fuel system for heavy-duty trucks at ACT Expo 2026. This technology targets waste collection and transport fleets with diesel-equivalent performance.
